declared: by Opus 5.5 on Oct 6, see git commit time; before any run
authority: Arnav, Oct 6: 'keep trying to make dravix better w/o the new pdfs'
rationale: The only lever that moved a record on Oct 5 was model averaging (LOI round 8: RF+ET+Ridge, +0.048, 9/10, critic SOUND WITH CAVEATS). This round tests the same recipe, fixed a priori, once on each other comparable target. No new features, no tuning, two candidates per target.

pHRR.data: train_phrr_promote_c2.py: T.load(replicate_target=True), has_mcc, 191 rows, groups = material with PlasticC->HIPS (64), features T.BASE+T.PHYS

Char Residue.data: train_char_residue_round1b.py --merge-groups data prep verbatim (567 rows, BASE + 5 category flags)
Char Residue.incumbent_model: its HGB (lr 0.05, 300 iter, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 10), raw target

FIGRA.data: train_figra_round1b.py data prep verbatim (197 rows / 67 materials, F2)
FIGRA.incumbent_model: its HGB (300 iter, lr 0.05, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 5), log1p target

candidates (per target, on the incumbent.b1: equal average of incumbent model, ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0) and Ridge(alpha=10) after median impute + missing indicators + StandardScaler
candidates (per target, on the incumbent.b2: equal average of incumbent model and the same ExtraTrees

target_scale: members are averaged on the incumbent's scale: pHRR and FIGRA inside the log1p wrapper (as the incumbent), Char Residue raw; TTI: GLM raw, ET and Ridge each wrapped in log1p TransformedTargetRegressor, average on the raw scale
step1: each incumbent must reproduce its record (mean and CI within 0.002) or that target is BLOCKED
protocol: repeated GroupKFold 5x10 with the incumbent's groups, repeat-0 group bootstrap CI (eval_protocol)
selection_rule: per target: best of b1/b2 by mean; replaces the incumbent only if >= 8/10 paired repeats better AND ci_lo >= incumbent ci_lo; then critic. Otherwise the incumbent stays.
exit_triggers: any ci_lo above its bar -> EXIT (pHRR already ahead on a different population: a higher pHRR stays 'different population')
